description: This file defines the 'HttplugFactory' class which implements methods for creating HTTP request, response, stream, and URI objects. It is a factory class that adheres to specific interfaces and is marked as deprecated, guiding users towards using another class instead.

classes.name: HttplugFactory
classes.description: A factory class that creates HTTP message, stream, and URI objects, implementing related interfaces and marked as deprecated.

methods.name: createRequest
methods.description: Creates and returns a new Request object with the specified method, URI, headers, body, and protocol version.

methods.name: createResponse
methods.description: Creates and returns a new Response object with the specified status code, reason phrase, headers, body, and protocol version.

methods.name: createStream
methods.description: Creates and returns a new Stream object with the given body content.

methods.name: createUri
methods.description: Creates and returns a Uri object from the given URI string or returns the UriInterface if already provided.
